payload.summary: Verify Caring Contacts is disabled in the live Railway production environment -- unverified, one operator read
payload.detail: UNVERIFIED: this is a check to run, not a known fault, and it must not be reported as one. Caring Contacts pages and API routes are gated by isCaringContactsWorkspaceEnabled (src/lib/caring-contacts-server/session.ts) and return 404 in production by default. The 2026-09-20 security audit could not read the live Railway variables without a provider call, so the production state was never confirmed either way. Why it is worth a P1 despite being unverified: if that workspace is open in production, the actor is resolved from a role cookie the module documents as forgeable in its own comments -- a caller can forge a role-only cookie outside a browser, so httpOnly is not an authorization boundary -- and a missing or invalid cookie defaults to the coordinator role, over a patient-data subsystem. The priority is for the cost of the check against the cost of being wrong, not for a suspected fault. PRECISION WORTH CARRYING, because it narrows the check: in production the demo path requires BOTH CARING_CONTACTS_DEMO_ENABLED=true AND a non-empty CARING_CONTACTS_SESSION_HMAC_SECRET, so a stray flag on its own opens nothing; the live path requires CARING_CONTACTS_DEMO_ENABLED=false plus that secret plus CARING_CONTACTS_DATABASE_URL. NEXT ACTION: with explicit user approval, since this is provider-backed under the API and provider confirmation boundary, read the variables on Railway project Database (5deaad0b-675a-4c13-978e-5ca2b5b877f9), production environment, services Database and worker. Confirm CARING_CONTACTS_DEMO_ENABLED is unset or false, and that CARING_CONTACTS_SESSION_HMAC_SECRET and CARING_CONTACTS_DATABASE_URL are absent unless live mode is deliberately intended. Record the result here either way; a clean result closes this row in one line.
payload.source: Session 2026-09-20, On Call Compliance page security audit
